_about: E-Way Bill canonical layer - what each canonical field is called in the raw merged e-way bill workbook (one flat sheet, one header row, no period banners at all -- see docs/EWB_CANONICAL_SPEC.md). A file is recognised as an e-way bill export by this exact header signature (checked before anything else, same test gst_core.classify_folder already used): 'EWB No.', 'From GSTIN & Name' and 'To GSTIN & Name' all present on some sheet's first 3 rows. Headings are compared after lower-casing and stripping every non-alphanumeric character. 'exact' = accepted spellings (first is the canonical one, the rest are aliases); 'type': 'num' = converted to a number (blank/#N/A/NA = 0), 'raw' = kept exactly as in the source (the combined 'No. & Dt.' text columns are split into number/date/time by the reader, not here, so the canonical file always keeps the untouched source text). 'required': true = the file is rejected with a plain message naming the missing column if it cannot be found.
